svg.title: tao_p3ach — sketchbook
svg.desc: My drawings: the title screen of Wandspell Chronicles (a hooded character in a dark forest with glowing fruit, and a PLAY / OPTION / QUIT menu with a cursor moving through it), a chibi sticker of a character with glasses who keeps making a surprised face, a chibi sticker with dark blue hair and yellow flowers, and two mushroom creature designs (a red-capped one and a brown-capped one).
